"""Panda cabinet controller: geometric IK, position servo, and a pinch-and-pull."""
import numpy as np
import mujoco
import rcb_panda as rp
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

ROT = np.array([[0.,0.,1.], [1.,0.,0.], [0.,1.,0.]])

class Controller:
    def __init__(self, session):
        self.s=session
        self.m=session.model
        self.ikdata=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
        self.sid=self.m.site('gripper').id
        self.kp=self.m.actuator_gainprm[:7,0].copy()

    def pose(self,q):
        self.ikdata.qpos[:7]=q
        mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,self.ikdata)
        return self.ikdata.site_xpos[self.sid].copy(),self.ikdata.site_xmat[self.sid].reshape(3,3).copy()

    def ik(self,pos,rot=ROT,seed=None):
        if seed is None: seed=self.s.data.qpos[:7].copy()
        seed=np.clip(seed,self.s.lower[:7]+1e-5,self.s.upper[:7]-1e-5)
        def fun(q):
            p,r=self.pose(q)
            return np.r_[p-pos,Rotation.from_matrix(rot@r.T).as_rotvec()*.35, (q-seed)*.00003]
        sol=least_squares(fun,seed,bounds=(self.s.lower[:7]+1e-6,self.s.upper[:7]-1e-6),xtol=1e-10,ftol=1e-10,gtol=1e-10,max_nfev=180)
        p,r=self.pose(sol.x)
        if np.linalg.norm(p-pos)>.002 or np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(rot@r.T).as_rotvec())>.02:
            print('IK residual',p-pos,Rotation.from_matrix(rot@r.T).as_rotvec(),flush=True)
        return sol.x

    def step_joint(self,q,finger):
        # Feedforward gravity compensates the finite stiffness of position actuators.
        d=self.s.data
        targets=np.r_[q+d.qfrc_bias[:7]/self.kp,finger]
        return self.s.step(targets)

    def move_joint(self,q,finger,steps=150):
        start=self.s.data.qpos[:7].copy()
        for i in range(steps):
            u=(i+1)/steps
            u=u*u*(3-2*u)
            self.step_joint(start+(q-start)*u,finger)

    def move_cart(self,pos,rot=ROT,finger=.04,steps=150):
        p0=self.s.data.site_xpos[self.sid].copy()
        r0=self.s.data.site_xmat[self.sid].reshape(3,3).copy()
        rv=Rotation.from_matrix(rot@r0.T).as_rotvec()
        q=self.s.data.qpos[:7].copy()
        for i in range(steps):
            u=(i+1)/steps
            u=u*u*(3-2*u)
            p=p0+(pos-p0)*u
            r=Rotation.from_rotvec(rv*u).as_matrix()@r0
            q=self.ik(p,r,seed=q)
            self.step_joint(q,finger)

    def hold(self,q,finger,steps=100):
        for _ in range(steps): self.step_joint(q,finger)

    def report(self,label):
        st=self.s.state()
        print(label,'steps',self.s.steps,'grip',np.round(st['gripper_pos'],5),'object',np.round(st['object_pos'],5),'finger',np.round(st['qpos'][7:9],5),'check',self.s.check(),flush=True)
        for c in self.s.data.contact:
            n1=self.m.geom(c.geom1).name; n2=self.m.geom(c.geom2).name
            if n1 or n2:
                force=np.zeros(6); mujoco.mj_contactForce(self.m,self.s.data,c.id,force) if hasattr(c,'id') else None
                print('contact',n1,n2,c.dist,flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
    import imageio.v3 as iio
    s=rp.Session('/app/instance.json')
    c=Controller(s)
    seed=s.data.qpos[:7].copy()
    for x in [.4,.495,.2]:
        q=c.ik(np.array([x,0,.5]),seed=seed)
        print('IK',x,q,'pose',c.pose(q)[0],flush=True)
        seed=q
    s.record_start()
    q=c.ik(np.array([.4,0,.5]))
    c.move_joint(q,.04,200)
    c.hold(q,.04,75)
    c.report('pregrasp')
    iio.imwrite('/app/output/pregrasp.png',s.render_grid())
    c.move_cart(np.array([.495,0,.5]),steps=150)
    q=c.ik(np.array([.495,0,.5]))
    c.hold(q,.04,50)
    c.report('approached')
    iio.imwrite('/app/output/approached.png',s.render_grid())
    c.hold(q,0,100)
    c.report('closed')
    iio.imwrite('/app/output/closed.png',s.render_grid())
    c.move_cart(np.array([s.target_pos[0]-.005,0,.5]),finger=0,steps=500)
    q=c.ik(np.array([s.target_pos[0]-.005,0,.5]))
    c.hold(q,0,100)
    c.report('pulled')
    iio.imwrite('/app/output/pulled.png',s.render_grid())
    A=s.record_stop()
    s.save_trajectory(A)
    print('replay',s.replay(A),flush=True)
    if s._renderer: s._renderer.close()
